{{Youmay|the gemstone|the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lapis Sheqoa]] or the ''[[Lapiz Cutter/Legends|Lapiz Cutter]]'', the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class shuttle]] of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]}}
'''Lapis''' or '''lapiz''' was a blue gemstone found in major quantities across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as flat plates or sheets. It was used for art and in the creation of flat surfaces, particularly tabletops.

Lapis from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Draboon/Legends|Draboon]] was used to furnish the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Duke/Legends|duchess]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].<ref name="TCWIV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref>
